# webular

> Search, scrape, crawl, and answer with sources, from your own machine. A CLI and MCP server with one optional key: Jev.

webular runs every command with no key. `webular mcp` serves 24 MCP tools over stdio. With `--json`, every command prints the same JSON shape.

## Install

- [Install webular](https://webular.dev/install.md): the one-line install, npm, Bun, pnpm, from source, platforms, upgrade, and uninstall.
- [Keys](https://webular.dev/keys.md): no key needed; set the optional Jev key per OS and shell.
- [Security](https://webular.dev/security.md): verifying a download, what the tools reach, and reporting a flaw.

## MCP tools

- [Add webular to your agent](https://webular.dev/install.md#agents): the command or config block for each MCP client.
- [MCP tools](https://webular.dev/tools.md): all 24 tools, grouped by job, read-only or not.
- [Use webular from your agent](https://webular.dev/agents/index.md): the plugin, results and paging, and agent-mode safety.

## Skills

- [Skills](https://webular.dev/agents/index.md#skills): webular-research, webular-interview, human-language, and rich-and-native-markdown.

## CLI

- [Commands](https://webular.dev/commands.md): every command with an example, global options, and exit codes.

## Optional

- [Benchmarks](https://webular.dev/benchmarks.md): the committed peer run, losses included.
- [Privacy](https://webular.dev/privacy.md): what webular sends where.
- [Support](https://webular.dev/support.md): where to ask, report a bug, or report a flaw.
- [Docs index](https://webular.dev/docs.md): every repo doc.
